extracted.intended_audience: research administrators, librarians, grant officers, and researchers interested in historical NSF awards
extracted.subtask_description: Creating or using a comprehensive catalog/report of a funding agency's grants and awards (here: NSF Fiscal Year 1972), including topical organization, per-entry metadata, and fellowship/traineeship listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization by topic areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Grants and awards for 1972 are organized by topic areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The table of contents shows major categories (e.g., 'SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH PROJECT SUPPORT', Biology subfields, Astronomy, Engineering, Atmospheric and Earth Sciences, Materials, Institutional Support, Specialized Research Facilities and Equipment Support, Research Applied to National Needs, National Research Centers, International Cooperative Scientific Activities, Science Information Services, Science Education Support, Planning and Policy Studies, Fellowship and Traineeship Awards', etc.). Use these topic headings to group entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical ordering within topic areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Within each topic area the entries are listed by state geographical locations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under each topical subheading, entries are grouped by U.S. state (and foreign locations where applicable), with state headings (e.g., CALIFORNIA, MASSACHUSETTS) followed by institution-level entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Per-entry core fields (name, institution, grant amount)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry contains the name(s) of the person(s) conducting the research, the institution at which the research was conducted and the amount of the grant received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries typically include: principal investigator name(s), project title or brief description, institution, grant/program code, duration (months), and dollar amount (e.g., 'MITCHELL, HERSCHEL K; REGULATION OF DEVELOPMENT IN DROSOPHILA (B023343 001); 24 MONTHS $50,000'). These are the minimum metadata expected per listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of grant identifiers and durations
rubrics_metrics.description: Grant/program identifiers (codes) and project durations are shown with each entry (e.g., '(B030699); 24 MONTHS').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The catalog records the program/grant code (alphanumeric in parentheses) and the award duration in months alongside award amounts; these are used for tracking/program classification and temporal context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification of award categories (e.g., Non-Classified)
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level classification labels are used (e.g., 'SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH PROJECT SUPPORT / NON-CLASSIFIED').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use classification headers to distinguish types or security/classification status of awards; in this volume 'NON-CLASSIFIED' is explicitly indicated for Scientific Research Project Support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed topical subfields
rubrics_metrics.description: Major topical areas are subdivided into specific subfields (e.g., under Biology: 'CELLULAR BIOLOGY', 'Ecology and Systematic Biology', 'Molecular Biology', 'Psychobiology', 'Neurobiology').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The table of contents lists many narrow subfields; the catalog preserves that granularity so users can find discipline-specific awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of specialized award types and facility/equipment support
rubrics_metrics.description: The report separately lists specialized awards and support categories such as 'Specialized Research Facilities and Equipment Support', 'University Atmospheric Research Facilities', 'Oceanographic Research Vessels and Facilities', 'High Energy Facilities', 'Chemistry Research Instruments', and 'Specialized Engineering and Materials Research Facilities'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish between project grants and capital/facility/instrument awards; entries for equipment or facility support typically note the item or facility and sometimes include institutional operations or construction items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage of conferences, workshops, and special projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings include conference and workshop support, advisory/planning studies, operation/maintenance of stock centers, and other special project awards (e.g., 'CONFERENCE ON TRANSCRIPTIONAL AND TRANSLATIONAL MECHANISMS', 'MAINTENANCE OF A YEAST GENETICS STOCK CENTER').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The catalog records non-research-project awards (conferences, workshops, maintenance of collections, advisory studies) with the same metadata fields (PI/organizer, institution, grant code, duration, amount).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of institutional support and computing activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections list 'Institutional Support for Science and Computing Activities', including 'Institutional Grants for Science', 'Computing Activities', 'Computer Science and Engineering', 'Computing Applications in Research', and 'Computer Innovation in Education'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institution-level awards for institutional capacity, computing resources, and computing-related programs are cataloged separately from individual research project awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship and traineeship awards and institution lists
rubrics_metrics.description: The volume includes 'FELLOWSHIP AND TRAINEESHIP AWARDS' and lists 'Institutions Granted Traineeships and Chosen by Graduate Fellowship Awardees—Fiscal Year 1972' grouped by state and also 'Foreign Institutions Chosen by Graduate Fellowship Awardees'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For fellowships/traineeships the catalog provides institution-level lists (many institutions by state), used to document where trainees and fellows were placed or chose to go; these lists are part of the report's metadata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Graduate fellowship awards broken down by field
rubrics_metrics.description: Graduate fellowship awards are summarized by field (e.g., ENGINEERING SCIENCES, PHYSICAL SCIENCES, LIFE & MEDICAL SCIENCES, SOCIAL SCIENCES & PSYCHOLOGY, MATHEMATICAL SCIENCES) with subfields enumerated (e.g., Aeronautical, Chemical, Biochemistry, Botany, Genetics).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The volume provides field-level tallies and breakdowns useful for analysis of award distribution across disciplines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standardized program abbreviations and program-type labels
rubrics_metrics.description: Program-level abbreviations and labels are used in entries (examples: 'COSIP D RESEARCH INITIATION', 'OTHER PROGRAM AWARDS (01AWDS)', 'Y010451').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program names and abbreviated codes appear with entries; the catalog relies on these standardized identifiers for program grouping and cross-reference. Maintain the original codes to preserve traceability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability and ordering information for the report
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication and ordering details are provided: available from the Superintendent of Documents, U.S. Government Printing Office, Washington, D.C. 20402; price $3.75; Stock Number 3800-00127; MF-$0.75 HC-$11.40 PLUS POSTAGE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include vendor/publisher, price, stock number, and distribution notes in the catalog header so readers know how to obtain copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of PI/fellow name lists and disciplinary tagging
rubrics_metrics.description: The volume lists individual names (e.g., long alphabetical lists under 'FELLOWSHIP AND TRAINEESHIP AWARDS') with their associated discipline tags (e.g., 'Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Biology, General').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide name + discipline metadata for fellowship awardees; these lists serve as an index of personnel associated with awards in the fiscal year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monetary amounts and temporal context recorded
rubrics_metrics.description: Each award entry records dollar amounts and duration (months), giving the funding level and temporal span for the award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary and temporal data allow budgetary and historical analyses; ensure amounts are recorded precisely and durations are captured consistently.
